newsitem.title: USA: Best Buy to report sales quarterly.
newsitem.headline: Best Buy to report sales quarterly.

text.p: Best Buy Co Inc said Thursday it will begin reporting its sales on a quarterly basis, instead of monthly as it is currently doing.
"We will not report monthly," said Best Buy spokeswoman Susan Hoff.
She added that, under Securities and Exchange Commission guidelines, sales results need only be reported quarterly.
"Many of the companies we compete against report on a quarterly basis," Hoff added.

The company also will hold quarterly conference calls to review industry trends and quarterly financial results. The first of these calls is scheduled for April 9, when it expects to release its fiscal 1997 earnigns.

Best Buy, a specialty retailer of name brand consumer electronics, personal computers, home office products, entertainment software and appliances, earlier today reported a three percent drop in its February same store sales.
Same store sales for the fiscal fourth quarter ended March 1 were off 11 percent.
